records.c: Auckland boss sprite source. The file contains fourteen cels with curved body edges, panels and a solid mask; $4808 feeds this staging area into VIC bank 3 at $F800.
Auckland initial object array for bit 7 marks an activated record, and bits 0 and 6 can keep it out of the activation scan at $297A. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Auckland initial object array for world X values tested against window edges $2B and $2C at $299A and $299E. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Auckland initial object array for world Y values tested against window edges $2D and $2E at $29A5 and $29A9. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Auckland initial object array for fourth bytes copied into $1C at $29E4 and written back at $2A40. $41BE rebuilds it from the selected round record.
Auckland round 1 object records. The scan starts at index $0B. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Auckland round 2 object records. The scan starts at index $0C. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Auckland round 3 object records. The scan starts at index $0E. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Auckland round 4 object records. The scan starts at index $13. The following 64 four-byte groups transpose into $9800, $9840, $9880 and $98C0 at $41EE.
Little-endian pointers to the four Auckland round object lists. $41D6 selects a pointer with twice the round number.
Auckland per-glyph attributes. The VIC color comes from the low nibble. Gameplay probes test the high bits at sites such as $0F34 and $0F3B.
Auckland map rows 0–7, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Auckland map rows 8–15, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Auckland map rows 16–23, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Auckland map rows 24–31, numbered from the map origin. Each row is 128 metatile IDs. The column renderer at $2473 expands IDs through $5600/$5700.
Auckland definitions for metatiles $00–$3F. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Auckland definitions for metatiles $40–$7F. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Auckland definitions for metatiles $80–$BF. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Auckland definitions for metatiles $C0–$FF. Each is a four-column set of four glyphs, indexed as four times the column plus the row at $24C0–$24F7.
Auckland disk-loaded initial bytes for the first playfield matrix. The map column renderer writes its displayed rows beginning at $C0F0.
Auckland disk-loaded initial bytes for the second playfield matrix. The renderer pairs its $C4F0 output with $C0F0 in the first matrix.
Auckland playfield character graphics at the VIC bank-3 charset base. Each of its 256 screen codes selects eight bytes.
Arches, wall edges and foliage or roof fragments occupy the upper glyph codes, with solid color cells near the end.
